notes.8: Question 8 The topic of market failure sometimes causes confusion. For question 10 only 22% chose the correct option B which gave an example of an externality. 47% chose A, 22% chose option C and 9% option D. Option A is an example of the working of the market; the fact that firms closed does not mean the market ‘failed’.
notes.22: Question 22 asked about external economies of scale. 41% chose the correct answer D. 22% chose A, 17% chose B and 20% chose C. Those who chose the incorrect answer were confused with internal economies of scale.
